skills: Up to 5 slashes: two Physical, three Frost. The 5th blocks attacks.

Hold with 2+ Fallen Frost: sheathes into Shimotsuki Stance and charges up to 3 levels, 2 Frost per level. Releasing (or running out) unleashes a draw slash for massive Frost DMG by charge level. Holds up to 6 Frost; enters battle with 3.
Quick dash dodge; mash or hold for a long-distance dash.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
Rushing slashes for massive Frost DMG (+2 Fallen Frost). Press again with enough Energy for a heavy follow-up for massive Frost DMG (+2 more).
Wide slash for massive Frost DMG.
Wide slashes, a pause, then a finisher for massive Frost DMG. Gives 3 Fallen Frost and +30% Ice DMG for 12s.

core.name: Searing Cold
core.text:
Her Frost DMG applies Icefire for 30s; against Icefire targets her Frost Anomaly Buildup Rate rises by 100% of her CRIT Rate (max 80%). Her Frost buildup has its own gauge: her Freeze, Shatter and Frostbite can trigger Disorder with other Anomalies, Ice included.
Applying Frostbite to an Icefire target spends it for Frostburn - Break: Frost DMG equal to {0}% of ATK, and the enemy enters Frostburn, where everyone builds {1}% more Anomaly (she can't reapply Icefire to it). Frostburn ends with Frostbite, or if another Anomaly overwrites it. Frostburn - Break gives 1 Fallen Frost (once per 10s).

ability.name: Bask in Frost
ability.text: Shimotsuki DMG +60%. When any squad member triggers Disorder, she gets 2 Fallen Frost and her next Shimotsuki Stance ignores 30% Ice RES.

mindscapes: Each Fallen Frost spent in Shimotsuki Stance makes Shimotsuki ignore 6% DEF (max 6, until the Stance ends). A level-3 Shimotsuki on a Frostburn enemy ends Frostburn and gives the squad +20% Anomaly Buildup Rate for 10s.
Kazahana and Dodge Counter DMG +30%. Kazahana's final 5th-hit move gives 1 Fallen Frost. Enters battle with 6 Fallen Frost and +15% CRIT Rate.
Frostburn - Break DMG +30% and gives 250 more Decibels.
Shimotsuki Stance gives Polar: Shimotsuki DMG +30%, and she draws automatically as Frost is spent without breaking the charge (up to 3 draws per Stance).
